subject: craft
angle: Craft paper texture under a thumb
caption:
You run your thumb across the edge of the invitation card and feel that slight, fibrous grain of heavy craft paper.

Black ink sits deep inside the cottony texture, matte and warm, without any cheap plastic sheen.

Older relatives keep this tucked inside a book or pinned on the fridge kasi it feels like a real keepsake.
